The diode inside the external control valve of some DENSO compressors for Mercedes-Benz applications serves to eliminate fly back. Fly back is a sudden voltage spike that occurs across an inductive load when its supply current is abruptly reduced or interrupted. The diode's placement, either within the electronic control unit (ECU) or the external control valve, depends on the specific vehicle application. It is crucial to install the correct type of compressor; if a compressor with an internal diode is replaced by one without it, the compressor will not function, and the ECU will log a Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) [2].

### References
